_note: VFX's energy look (docs/vfx/beam-look.md): the signature beams' layers and each fighter's flavour, keyed by roster id in lower case (protagonist, rival, reference; the Anti-hero IS the roster's RIVAL). A beam's colour is its owner's lane colour (data/art/colour-vision.json follows); a flavour sets the second tint's hue shift (the ripple moves hue at the same luminance), the ripple's wavelength and rate in Hz (2 or slower, Legal fx03), the edge turbulence and softness, the heel's swell and `width_k`, how thick the beam is against the sim's width. `rival_short` is the one thin beam: the Anti-hero's short beam (a beam of 0.7 s or less). Read by render/vfx/beam_look.gd, never by the sim. Written by the VFX Director session (Claude, claude-sonnet-5-5), 2026-10-16. A missing key falls back to the same default in code. Art's colours (docs/art/beam-colours.md, 2026-10-16): the Rival's second tint turns +34 degrees (capped so it stays at 320 or less: `hue_max`), the Protagonist's turns +30 and -30 under the tritan preset (`hue_shift_tritan`), the dummy's +12.

rates._why: The moving marks this file's effects draw, with their rates, for the HUD and effects rate lists (Legal fx04, k06). hz: how often the mark repeats while its state lasts (0: steady); calm_hz: the same under Reduce flashing (the shipped default) and Reduced motion, which must be 1.5 or slower; strokes_only: thin rings and lines, no fill and no brightness change.

struggle_beat.what: the contraction ring and the ring that leaves it, on the 20-tick pulse of a beam struggle

struggle_surge.what: the ring on his beam and the bulge at the meeting point, one a surge

struggle_stray.what: the hiccup across his own beam

opening_ring.what: the ring on the chest of a fighter who is open to the launcher, steady after 4 ticks

shine.what: the striking hand's edge lines and ring while a light's perfect window is open

chase_trail.what: the trail behind a chaser or a returner, while it lasts

beam_ripple.what: the beam's hue ripple, 2 Hz or slower at any point, under a tenth of luminance (fx03)
